config_contents.description: Statistical downscaling by MOS (CCA, PCR; CPT/PyCPT approach) against the published pipeline, January-initialized FMAM (docs/53).

settings.predictor: Chosen inside the folds: SEAS5 ensemble-mean rainfall over the model box (1-degree cells), SEAS5 sea-surface temperature over 20S-20N, 30E-80W (2-degree cells), or both; first 25 members every year
settings.spread: cross-validated error variance x (1 + leverage of the forecast)
settings.blend: tercile probabilities blended with climatology, weight 0-1 (step 0.05) by inner leave-one-year-out RPS

provenance.uncommitted_check: code and configuration files this result depends on

references.incumbent: Published probabilities: MVS -> smoothed counts -> climatology blend
